title: Gantz
label: Quick read (from summaries)
premise: Teenagers Kei Kurono and Masaru Kato die in a subway accident and wake in an apartment where a black sphere sends the dead out to hunt aliens. Survivors earn points toward freedom or reviving the fallen, and the missions grow into a global alien invasion.
life_message: A life in which a selfish young man learns to risk himself for others when everything is at stake.

Nudity and erotic scenes (Wikipedia); a 15-year-old is sexually assaulted early on and female leads are sexualized (WWAC review; AniList Rape, Nudity signals).
Likely frequent profanity in an adult series (to verify).

Gun and weapon use, objectification of women (WWAC; AniList Guns tag).
